verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Grafana Alerting sending notifications to named integrations such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie. None of the cited material documents a registrable outbound webhook contact point that could trigger automated remediation or an agent. Chat and paging integrations are not webhooks, and the vague phrase "take action on your alerts" does not establish one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
